podcast.body: This album, released in 2005, sold more than 15 million copies globally and included a major hit single that deliberately echoed Kraftwerk's "Computer Love." Kraftwerk received songwriting credits for this track, showcasing their enduring influence and financial benefits. "Given that this was a major hit single around the world, and with the X and Y album selling something north of 15 million copies, the guys in Craftwork continue to get some pretty fat checks in the mail."
